MemoService is served over two protocols. I am identifying their names and exact file paths.

The two protocols are gRPC-Gateway (HTTP/REST) and Connect.

gRPC-Gateway registration occurs in `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/v1.go` at line 108 via `RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer`. The actual registration function lives in generated code at `/bench/repo/proto/gen/api/v1/memo_service.pb.gw.go`.

Connect registration and wrapping happen in `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go` at line 40 via `NewMemoServiceHandler`. The handler factory is in generated code at `/bench/repo/proto/gen/api/v1/apiv1connect/memo_service.connect.go`. Service method wrapping is in `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go`.

A comment at line 64 of `v1.go` explicitly states that `RegisterGateway` registers both the gRPC-Gateway and Connect handlers. The gRPC-Gateway routes mount under `/api/v1/*`, while Connect routes use `/memos.api.v1.*`. In `connect_services.go`, `ConnectServiceHandler` wraps the APIV1Service methods for MemoService.
